strings.text: She doesn't put the light out. Let them know someone is still here.
strings.translation: Світла вона не гасить. Хай знають, що тут іще хтось є.

strings.text: The phone has been silent for three weeks.
Someone is standing by the forest again.
Every night, a few steps closer.
It is standing right by the house, under the window.
strings.translation: Воно стоїть біля самого дому, під вікном.

strings.text: It has come out of the forest and stands in the middle of the field.
strings.translation: Воно вийшло з лісу й стоїть посеред поля.

strings.text: A tall pale figure stands at the edge of the forest.
strings.translation: На узліссі стоїть висока бліда постать.

strings.text: The light in the window has gone out.
The door of the house is open; light spills onto the snow.
strings.translation: Двері дому відчинені, світло лягло на сніг.
